What to verify as you learn

Start by connecting /nix/store, the Nix language, and system configuration. Then understand flake input pinning and Home Manager's user-level boundaries before learning development environments, ARM, CI, cross-compilation, and secrets as projects require them. build only builds, test activates without setting the boot default, boot sets the next boot, and switch activates immediately and sets the default; verify these stages separately. Third-party tutorials and opinions retain their original links in the resources, but they do not replace the options and source code for your currently pinned version.
